dataset.title: Evidence extracted from handbooks
dataset.description: Claims extracted verbatim from handbook tables, each pointing at the handbook section.

records.name: Laser use in Wafer: SiC boule slicing
records.claim: SiC boule slicing uses NIR ps laser forming a subsurface split layer at ~1 µm (Tens of W) on SiC for Reduce kerf loss on SiC wafering.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: SiC boule slicing | NIR ps laser forming a subsurface split layer | ~1 µm | Tens of W | SiC | Reduce kerf loss on SiC wafering | DISCO (KABRA), Halo Industries, others

records.name: Laser use in Wafer: Wafer marking (front/back)
records.claim: Wafer marking (front/back) uses DPSS / fibre, often green or UV; soft-mark and hard-mark at 1 064, 532, 355 nm (Few W average, ns pulses) on Si, SiC, GaAs, glass for Wafer ID / OCR / 2D codes (SEMI T7, M12/M13).
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: Wafer marking (front/back) | DPSS / fibre, often green or UV; soft-mark and hard-mark | 1 064, 532, 355 nm | Few W average, ns pulses | Si, SiC, GaAs, glass | Wafer ID / OCR / 2D codes (SEMI T7, M12/M13) | EO Technics, Keyence, Han’s Laser, domestic integrators

records.name: Laser use in Fab: Laser annealing — dopant activation
records.claim: Laser annealing — dopant activation uses Green DPSS, CO₂ (historic), excimer at 532 nm, 10.6 µm, 308 nm (ns–ms dwell) on Si, SiC backside for Ultra-shallow junction activation; IGBT and SiC backside contacts.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: Laser annealing — dopant activation | Green DPSS, CO₂ (historic), excimer | 532 nm, 10.6 µm, 308 nm | ns–ms dwell | Si, SiC backside | Ultra-shallow junction activation; IGBT and SiC backside contacts | Applied Materials, SCREEN (LASSE), Veeco, Mitsui, 3D-Micromac

records.name: Laser use in Lithography: EUV light source
records.claim: EUV light source uses CO₂ drive laser on Sn droplets at 10.6 µm (drive) → 13.5 nm (EUV) (Tens of kW drive) on Tin for EUV lithography.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: EUV light source | CO₂ drive laser on Sn droplets | 10.6 µm (drive) → 13.5 nm (EUV) | Tens of kW drive | Tin | EUV lithography | TRUMPF (drive laser) for ASML

records.name: Laser use in Lithography: DUV lithography source
records.claim: DUV lithography source uses Excimer at 248 nm (KrF), 193 nm (ArF) (~40–120 W) on — for Scanners.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: DUV lithography source | Excimer | 248 nm (KrF), 193 nm (ArF) | ~40–120 W | — | Scanners | Cymer (ASML), Gigaphoton

records.name: Laser use in Implant: Laser annealing — dopant activation
records.claim: Laser annealing — dopant activation uses Green DPSS, CO₂ (historic), excimer at 532 nm, 10.6 µm, 308 nm (ns–ms dwell) on Si, SiC backside for Ultra-shallow junction activation; IGBT and SiC backside contacts.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: Laser annealing — dopant activation | Green DPSS, CO₂ (historic), excimer | 532 nm, 10.6 µm, 308 nm | ns–ms dwell | Si, SiC backside | Ultra-shallow junction activation; IGBT and SiC backside contacts | Applied Materials, SCREEN (LASSE), Veeco, Mitsui, 3D-Micromac

records.name: Laser use in Dicing: Laser grooving (low-k)
records.claim: Laser grooving (low-k) uses UV / green ps–ns at 355, 532 nm (~5–20 W) on Low-k dielectric, metal stacks for Remove street layers before blade dicing.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: Laser grooving (low-k) | UV / green ps–ns | 355, 532 nm | ~5–20 W | Low-k dielectric, metal stacks | Remove street layers before blade dicing | DISCO, ASMPT, EO Technics

records.name: Laser use in Dicing: Laser full-cut dicing
records.claim: Laser full-cut dicing uses UV ns/ps, fs for thin wafers at 355, 343, 1 030 nm (~10–50 W) on Si, GaAs, sapphire, thin wafers for Die singulation.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: Laser full-cut dicing | UV ns/ps, fs for thin wafers | 355, 343, 1 030 nm | ~10–50 W | Si, GaAs, sapphire, thin wafers | Die singulation | DISCO, ASMPT, EO Technics, Han’s

records.name: Laser use in Dicing: Stealth dicing
records.claim: Stealth dicing uses NIR ns/ps, focused internally at ~1 064–1 342 nm (Si transparent above ~1.1 µm) (Few W) on Si, SiC, sapphire, glass for Zero-kerf dicing for MEMS, memory.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: Stealth dicing | NIR ns/ps, focused internally | ~1 064–1 342 nm (Si transparent above ~1.1 µm) | Few W | Si, SiC, sapphire, glass | Zero-kerf dicing for MEMS, memory | DISCO (Hamamatsu SD engine)

records.name: Laser use in Flip chip: Laser-assisted bonding (LAB)
records.claim: Laser-assisted bonding (LAB) uses NIR area beam at ~980 nm (Hundreds of W to kW area) on Flip-chip solder joints for Low-warpage flip-chip bonding for thin packages.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: Laser-assisted bonding (LAB) | NIR area beam | ~980 nm | Hundreds of W to kW area | Flip-chip solder joints | Low-warpage flip-chip bonding for thin packages | Pac Tech, K&S, Korean LAB suppliers

records.name: Laser use in Flip chip: Temporary-bond laser debond
records.claim: Temporary-bond laser debond uses UV DPSS at 355 nm (Few W) on Release layer on glass carrier for Advanced packaging / thin-wafer handling.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: Temporary-bond laser debond | UV DPSS | 355 nm | Few W | Release layer on glass carrier | Advanced packaging / thin-wafer handling | EV Group, SUSS, Brewer Science (materials)

records.name: Laser use in Molding: Laser cleaning
records.claim: Laser cleaning uses Pulsed fibre (ns) at 1 064 nm (20–500 W) on Oxides, organics, mould residue for Lead-frame and pad cleaning; mould flash removal (deflash); pre-bond.
records.section: Part XXXII — Lasers in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing
records.excerpt: Laser cleaning | Pulsed fibre (ns) | 1 064 nm | 20–500 W | Oxides, organics, mould residue | Lead-frame and pad cleaning; mould flash removal (deflash); pre-bond | Various; domestic integrators
